_comment: Pan-India algo trading platforms and entities: broker APIs, retail no-code platforms,
backtesting/analytics tools and institutional algo vendors.
- Everything in this file is CURATED. It is published with provenance:'curated' and the
UI must say so. No figure here is regulator-verified.
- `works_with` entries are broker ids from brokers_master.json, so the site can
cross-link a platform to the broker profiles it executes through. Only list brokers
we track; an integration with an untracked broker goes in `notes` instead.
- Do NOT record SEBI/exchange empanelment status per platform until it can be pulled
from the exchanges' published empanelment lists. Guessing a compliance status is
- `pricing` is a broad indication (free / freemium / subscription / per-order), not a
rate card. Platforms change pricing constantly; the profile-claim flow is how a
- Keep summaries factual and neutral: what the thing is, not whether it is good.

broker_api.label: Broker trading APIs
broker_api.blurb: Official REST/WebSocket APIs from brokers themselves — the execution layer most retail algos ultimately trade through.

no_code.label: No-code algo platforms
no_code.blurb: Build, backtest and deploy strategies without writing code; execution routed to a connected broker account.

analytics.label: Backtesting & options analytics
analytics.blurb: Strategy research, options chains, Greeks and historical simulation. Some offer one-click execution via broker integrations.

institutional.label: Institutional algo & OMS/EMS vendors
institutional.blurb: Exchange-empanelled software vendors supplying algo engines, order and execution management systems to brokers and institutions.

platforms.name: Kite Connect
platforms.summary: Zerodha's HTTP/WebSocket trading API: orders, positions, holdings, historical candles and live market data for individual and startup use.

platforms.name: SmartAPI
platforms.summary: Angel One's free trading and market-data API with SDKs in Python, Java, NodeJS and Go; widely used by third-party algo platforms as an execution venue.

platforms.name: Upstox Developer API
platforms.summary: Upstox's v2 REST and WebSocket API for orders and market feeds, free for personal trading use.

platforms.name: FYERS API
platforms.summary: Trading and data API from FYERS with granular historical data access, positioned squarely at the DIY algo-trader segment.

platforms.name: DhanHQ API
platforms.summary: Dhan's trading API with live order streaming and a Trader's Control panel for API-based traders; no charge for API access itself.

platforms.name: Breeze API
platforms.summary: ICICI Direct's Breeze API — a bank-broker opening its execution and data stack to retail algo traders.

platforms.name: Kotak Neo Trade API
platforms.summary: Kotak Securities' Neo API suite for order placement and market quotes, offered free after the broker scrapped API charges.

platforms.name: Shoonya API
platforms.summary: Finvasia's zero-brokerage platform exposes a free trading API, making it a common execution leg for cost-sensitive algo setups.

platforms.name: ANT API
platforms.summary: Alice Blue's ANT (Analyse aNd Trade) API platform, plus ready integrations with most third-party algo platforms.

platforms.name: MO Trading API
platforms.summary: Motilal Oswal's investor API programme offering order and data endpoints from a full-service house.

platforms.name: Paytm Money Equity API
platforms.summary: Paytm Money's developer API for equity and F&O order placement aimed at retail algo users.

platforms.name: Streak
platforms.summary: No-code strategy creation, backtesting and live deployment; grew up inside the Zerodha ecosystem and now connects to multiple brokers.

platforms.name: Tradetron
platforms.summary: Condition-builder algo platform with a strategy marketplace where creators rent strategies to subscribers; executes across dozens of Indian brokers.

platforms.name: AlgoTest
platforms.summary: Free options-strategy backtesting on historical F&O data with paid forward-testing and live execution through connected brokers.

platforms.name: AlgoBulls
platforms.summary: Algo marketplace and execution platform spanning retail packs and a developer-facing Python framework (pyalgotrading).

platforms.name: Quantman
platforms.summary: Template-driven F&O strategy builder with deep historical backtests and one-click live deployment via broker APIs.

platforms.name: Speedbot
platforms.summary: App-first algo platform with an options bot builder and per-strategy marketplace pricing.

platforms.name: uTrade Algos
platforms.summary: Retail no-code strategy builder from institutional vendor uTrade Solutions, sold through partner brokers.

platforms.name: Keev
platforms.summary: Sharekhan-backed strategy automation platform: build or pick strategies and auto-execute through a Sharekhan account.

platforms.name: Squareoff
platforms.summary: Pre-built trading bots with fixed monthly pricing that place trades automatically in the user's own broker account.

platforms.name: Sensibull
platforms.summary: India's largest options-trading platform: chains, Greeks, strategy builder and broker-connected execution. Analytics rather than automation — no unattended algos.

platforms.name: Quantsapp
platforms.summary: Options analytics suite with open-interest tooling, strategy scanners and structured F&O education.

platforms.name: Opstra
platforms.summary: Options strategy builder, IV charts and positional analytics from the Definedge stable, which also runs its own SEBI-registered broking arm.

platforms.name: StockMock
platforms.summary: Popular options backtesting tool for NIFTY/BANKNIFTY strategies with slippage modelling; research only, no live execution.

platforms.name: Symphony Presto / XTS
platforms.summary: Exchange-empanelled algo trading system (Presto ATS) and the XTS API stack that several brokers resell to their own API clients.

platforms.name: Greeksoft
platforms.summary: Low-latency algo and options-market-making software deployed at broker dealing desks across NSE, BSE and MCX.

platforms.name: ODIN / 63 moons
platforms.summary: The incumbent multi-exchange OMS deployed across Indian broking for decades; its ecosystem spans dealer terminals and algo modules.

platforms.name: uTrade Solutions
platforms.summary: Trading-technology vendor supplying algo engines, risk layers and white-label platforms to brokers; parent of the retail uTrade Algos product.
